caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress, rendered in shades of light beige and cream. The dress features short sleeves and a fitted bodice with a front button and lace panel detail. The bodice extends into a narrow waist and then flares out into a long, floor-length skirt. The skirt is adorned with multiple horizontal rows of lace ruffles, and the lower section of the skirt displays a fan-like pattern above a pleated hem. Attached to the back of the dress is an extended, rounded train that spreads out to the left side of the drawing, bordered with a subtle darker trim. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or figures present. The artist’s signature, “M. Boyd,” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Evening Dress
